basic_details.short_information: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd (TMB), one of India's leading old private sector banks, has released the TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026 notification inviting online applications for eight specialist IT roles - Software Developer (Manager and Assistant Manager cadre), Data Scientist, Statistician, CBS Support Engineers, Software Engineer (Software Programmers), and Oracle HCM specialists (Payroll & Integrations, and Talent, Workflow & Experience). Online registration opened on 28 July 2026 and closes on 10 August 2026. There is no application fee, and the posting location is Chennai.

application_fee.details: There is no application fee for TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026. The official notification states the application fee as Nil for all posts.

how_to_apply: Visit the official TMB careers website: https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/
Download and read the detailed advertisement under "Recruitment of Specialist Officers" before applying.
Click "Apply Online" and register for the post of "Recruitment of Specialist Officer" using a valid personal email ID and mobile number.
Note the Registration Number and Password sent to your registered mobile number after successful registration.
Click the activation link sent to your registered email ID to access the Careers portal.
Log in with your Application/Registration Number and password, and fill in all application details carefully.
Upload your photograph, signature, and required document enclosures as per the specified size and dimension.
Review all details, then click "Confirm/Submit" to complete the registration.
Save and print the system-generated application form for future reference.
important_instructions: The posting for all selected candidates will be at Chennai; the job role and location are subject to transfer based on the Bank's requirements. Candidates must register their correct email ID and mobile number while creating their User ID, and keep both active until the recruitment process is complete. Candidate names (and father's/husband's name) must be spelt exactly as they appear on certificates/mark sheets; any mismatch may lead to disqualification. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification. Applications with incorrect, incomplete particulars, or without the required certificate copies are liable to be rejected. The Bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate ineligible candidates, at any stage of the process without assigning any reason. The Bank's decision is final.

content_sections.heading: TMB Specialist Officer IT Important Dates
TMB Specialist Officer IT Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026 covers the following eight roles. The official notification does not mention the number of vacancies for each post.

rows.minimum_experience: Minimum 8 years in Banking/FinTech, including 3+ years leading software development teams
3 years as Data Scientist in a bank/financial institution or with large databases (desirable)
5 years as Statistician in a bank/financial institution or with large databases (desirable)
Minimum 3 years working experience in large Banking Software
Minimum 2 years in Financial Compliance, Data Integrity, and Backend Systems
Minimum 3 years in User Interface, Approval Hierarchies and Learning/Support

content_sections.heading: TMB Specialist Officer IT Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: All eight roles under TMB Specialist Officer (IT) Recruitment 2026 require a B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/Information Technology, MCA, or an equivalent degree from a reputed university, except Data Scientist and Statistician, which have their own qualification requirements. Post-specific eligibility is detailed below. Candidates who have completed their B.E./B.Tech , MCA, or a related technical degree can also explore more IT Government and Private Sector Jobs and Banking Sector Jobs available across India.

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent
rows.key_experience_requirement: Minimum 8 years in Banking/FinTech with Software Development exposure; 3+ years leading development teams with 3 years Full Stack development experience; Java (J2EE)/Springboot, microservices, mobile app development (Native/Hybrid/Flutter), cloud (AWS/GCP)

rows.educational_qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
rows.key_experience_requirement: 3 years as Data Scientist in a bank/financial institution/large databases; strong Python/R programming; data visualization tools (SAS, Tableau, Power BI); predictive modelling (desirable)

rows.educational_qualification: Master's degree or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field
rows.key_experience_requirement: 5 years as Statistician in a bank/financial institution/large databases; statistical modelling; R, SAS software (desirable)

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent
rows.key_experience_requirement: Minimum 3 years in Software Development/Testing/Maintenance; Java (J2EE)/Springboot; Angular/NodeJS; microservices; Cloud (AWS/GCP); Docker

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent
rows.key_experience_requirement: Minimum 3 years' experience in large Banking Software; knowledge of Finacle 10x CBS scripting/development/customization; Java, Unix Scripts, Finacle Scripting (desirable)

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent
rows.key_experience_requirement: Minimum 3 years in Software Development/Testing/Maintenance; Full Stack Java (J2EE)/Springboot; Angular/NodeJS/JavaScript/JSP; microservices; Docker (desirable)

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent
rows.key_experience_requirement: Minimum 2 years in Financial Compliance, Data Integrity and Backend Systems; Oracle Fusion Payroll configuration; OIC, HDL, Fast Formulas; Oracle certifications desirable

rows.post: Oracle HCM – Talent, Workflow & Experience (Assistant Manager)
rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science/IT/MCA or equivalent
rows.key_experience_requirement: Minimum 3 years in User Interface, Approval Hierarchies and Learning/Support; VBCS, BPM Worklist, OTBI; Oracle certifications desirable

content_sections.heading: TMB Specialist Officer IT Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview, conducted either directly or through Video Conferencing. The mode, date, and time of the interview will be communicated individually to eligible candidates. The Bank's decision on eligibility, interview, and selection is final.

content_sections.heading: TMB Specialist Officer IT Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following self-attested documents along with the online application (each file within the size limit specified in the notification): Photograph (390 x 520 pixels, max 120 KB) Signature - not in capital letters (240 x 240 pixels, max 60 KB) Self-attested photo copy of SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet/Transfer Certificate (for age proof) Self-attested photo copy of Degree Certificate(s) Experience certificate(s) and Relieving Letter for previous employment(s) Last month's salary slip All enclosure scans must not exceed 250 KB each.

content_sections.heading: TMB Specialist Officer IT Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply only through the online mode on the official TMB careers portal: https://apps.tmbdigital.bank.in/tmb_careers/. No other mode of application submission will be accepted by the Bank. The online application must be submitted on or before 10 August 2026 . Apply Online / Official Careers Portal: Apply Here

content_sections.text: The posting for all selected candidates will be at Chennai; the job role and location are subject to transfer based on the Bank's requirements. The Bank reserves the right to reject any application, or eliminate ineligible candidates, at any stage of the process without assigning any reason. The Bank's decision is final.
